description: This header file 'compiler.h' provides utility functions to retrieve and append information about the compiler and C library used, such as compiler version and libc version, into a string buffer. It includes conditional compilation directives to support various compilers like Clang, GCC, and MSVC, and references external headers like 'strbuf.h' and potential system libraries.

methods.name: void get_compiler_info(struct strbuf * info)
methods.description: Appends compiler version information (Clang, GCC, MSVC) into a provided string buffer.

methods.name: void get_libc_info(struct strbuf * info)
methods.description: Appends libc version information (glibc) into a provided string buffer.
